question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Divergence
solution:
The correct answer is: **Convergence **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Divergence **means the act of moving away from each other or becoming different. (एक दूसरे से दूर जाने या अलग होने की क्रिया)

 
 
• **For example**: *The divergence of opinions among the team members led to lengthy discussions.*
 
 
 
• **Convergence **is the opposite of divergence, and it means the act of coming together or becoming similar. (एक साथ आने या एक जैसा बनने की क्रिया या भाव)
 
 
• **For example**: *The convergence of various cultures in the city creates a rich and diverse community.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of a word is a word that means the opposite of the given word.
 
• Therefore, the **antonym **of divergence is convergence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Existence **means the state of existing which is not related to the meaning of divergence. (अस्तित्‍व)
 
• **Resilience **means the ability to recover from difficulties, and it is not the opposite of divergence. (कठिनाइयों से उबरने की क्षमता)
 
• **Transience **means the state of being temporary or not lasting, and it is not the opposite of divergence. (अस्थायी या स्थायी न होने की अवस्था या भाव)
